name: WolframAlpha
job: Answer maths, science and factual computation questions.
auth: Free API key (AppID) sent as a query parameter
free_tier: Free AppID: up to 2,000 non-commercial API calls/month (official Wolfram products page)
verified: 2026-10-25: keyless call returned HTTP 400 {"status":400,"message":"Appid Missing"} — endpoint live, key enforced.
notes: Strong door, just locked: wrap once the founder creates a free AppID and parks it in the gateway vault. Free tier is non-commercial only; commercial use needs a paid plan.

name: VirusTotal
job: Check a file, URL, domain or IP against 70+ antivirus engines.
auth: Free API key in the x-apikey header
free_tier: Public API: 4 requests/minute, 500/day, 15,500/month; non-commercial use only
verified: 2026-10-25: keyless GET /api/v3/urls/{id} returned HTTP 401 AuthenticationRequiredError 'X-Apikey header is missing'.
notes: Free key from a VirusTotal account. Terms forbid commercial products on the public API — fine for Ansai's internal agents, revisit before selling access.

name: HaveIBeenPwned
job: Check whether an email or a password has appeared in known data breaches.
auth: Split: Pwned Passwords range API needs no key; the v3 breach-lookup API needs a paid key in the hibp-api-key header
free_tier: Pwned Passwords: free, keyless, no imposed rate limit (official support docs). v3 API: paid only, from $5.29/month for 10 requests/minute (Oct 2026 pricing)
verified: 2026-10-25: keyless GET api.pwnedpasswords.com/range/21BD1 returned HTTP 200 with real hash-suffix data; keyless v3 call returned HTTP 401 'Access denied due to missing hibp-api-key'.
notes: Wrap the free keyless Pwned Passwords endpoint now (password-breach check); the paid v3 email-lookup can be added later only if the job earns its $5.29/month.

name: Semantic Scholar
job: Search 214M+ academic papers and follow citations.
auth: None required; optional free API key (x-api-key header) strongly recommended
free_tier: Free. Keyless traffic shares one global pool and is throttled under load; a free personal key gets an introductory 1 request/second across all endpoints
verified: 2026-10-25: keyless live test returned HTTP 429 (rate limited), matching the earlier ansai-utils paper_search result. Endpoint and docs live (semanticscholar.org/product/api).
notes: Tool already built in ansai-utils; it works intermittently keyless. A free API key (requested from Semantic Scholar, delivered by email) makes it dependable — founder action to request one.

name: Archive.org
job: Find old copies of web pages and search the Internet Archive's media library.
free_tier: Free, keyless, no published quota for these read endpoints
verified: 2026-10-25: keyless availability call returned HTTP 200 with a real snapshot (google.com, archived 2026-10-24); advancedsearch returned HTTP 200 with 999,913 results for a title query.
notes: Fully open door — the reference case. wayback_lookup already runs in ansai-utils; add advancedsearch/metadata as archive_search next.

name: remove.bg
job: Remove the background from an image automatically.
auth: API key in the X-Api-Key header
free_tier: First 50 API calls per month free with a free account key (preview resolution); credits/subscription after that
verified: 2026-10-25: POST without a key returned HTTP 403 auth_failed 'Please authorize by providing either the Authorization or the X-Api-Key request header'.
notes: Clean single-job API. Wrap once a free key exists in the vault; 50 free calls/month is enough to prove agent value before paying.

name: TinEye
job: Reverse image search — find where an image appears online.
free_tier: None. Prepaid search bundles only: from $200 for 5,000 searches ($0.04/search); 1M searches for $10,000
verified: 2026-10-25: keyless call returned HTTP 401 {"code":401,"messages":["Please provide a valid API key."]}
notes: Door exists but the key costs real money up front. Park until a paying job needs reverse image search; no free way to prove value first.

name: Raindrop.io
job: Save, organise and search a personal bookmark library.
auth: OAuth 2.0, or a personal test token generated in account settings
free_tier: API access is free, including on free accounts; no paid API tier
notes: Needs the founder's own account token (it is his personal library, so the key is personal too — OAuth through the gateway when built, token never exposed to agents).

name: Cleanup.pictures (via Clipdrop)
job: Remove an unwanted object, person or text from a photo.
endpoint: https://clipdrop-api.co/cleanup/v1 (POST) — Cleanup.pictures itself has no API; the API lives in its sibling product Clipdrop (docs: clipdrop.co/apis)
auth: API key in the x-api-key header (Clipdrop)
free_tier: Small number of free test credits on signup; usage-based paid pricing after that
verified: 2026-10-25: POST to clipdrop-api.co/cleanup/v1 without a key returned HTTP 401 {"error":"The request is missing authentication: No api key provided"}. Third-party directories confirm Cleanup.pictures itself offers no API.
notes: Wrap the Clipdrop cleanup endpoint, not the cleanup.pictures website. Same team, same underlying job.

name: Unscreen
job: Remove the background from a video automatically.
free_tier: No free API tier; API access comes with paid Unscreen Pro plans (from ~$9/month for 3 video-minutes)
verified: 2026-10-25: keyless GET to api.unscreen.com/v1/videos returned HTTP 502 from the host (endpoint exists behind their gateway; no unauthenticated data returned). Docs confirm key-based API under paid Pro plans.
notes: Same parent company as remove.bg (Kaleido). Paid door; park next to TinEye until a video job pays for the key.

name: Printful
job: Print merchandise on demand and ship it to a customer when ordered.
auth: OAuth 2.0 for v2 / account API tokens for store operations; parts of the v1 catalog are publicly readable
free_tier: The API itself is free — you pay only for products actually printed and shipped
verified: 2026-10-25: keyless GET api.printful.com/products returned HTTP 200 with the real product catalogue; keyless GET /v2/catalog-products returned HTTP 401 'This endpoint requires Oauth authentication!'.
notes: Catalogue browsing can wrap today with no key at all; ordering needs the founder's Printful store connected by OAuth through the gateway.

name: Project Gutenberg (Gutendex)
job: Search and fetch 70,000+ free public-domain books.
free_tier: Free, keyless, community-run mirror of the Gutenberg catalogue (Project Gutenberg itself asks heavy users to mirror politely)
verified: Keyless live test 2026-10-25: GET gutendex.com/books?ids=11 -> HTTP 301 redirect, followed to 200 with real book JSON. Door open, keyless.
notes: Best exposed as catalogue RESOURCES (search + read a book) rather than a single tool call — content library, not a one-shot job. Works today with zero keys.

name: AlternativeTo
job: Find alternative software for a given app or service.
endpoint: None — no official public API found (https://alternativeto.net/api/ tested)
verified: 2026-10-25: GET alternativeto.net/api/ returned HTTP 404; documentation searches surfaced no official developer API (a legacy API was partner-restricted and is not publicly documented).
notes: No machine door. The job itself ('what else does X?') is answerable by an agent using web search over the public site as a human would — catalogue-only reference, no wrap.

name: JustWatch
job: Find which streaming service offers a film or show in a given country.
auth: Partner API key issued manually after applying (data-partner@justwatch.com); no self-serve signup
free_tier: None public. The unofficial endpoint used by their own apps prohibits commercial use and is unsupported
verified: 2026-10-25: docs check — official Partner Integrations documentation (apis.justwatch.com/docs/content_partner) confirms API access is partner-only; unofficial-API maintainers state JustWatch 'doesn't offer an open API and doesn't plan to'.
notes: Door exists but opens only to negotiated partners. Not worth a partnership chase for a catalogue entry; drop and revisit only if a client product needs streaming data.

name: DownDetector
job: Check whether a popular service is reported down right now.
auth: OAuth 2.0 client ID/secret issued to Enterprise subscribers
free_tier: No free API tier. API access is bundled in the paid Enterprise plan only (custom pricing); the free consumer plan has no API
verified: 2026-10-25: docs check — Downdetector's own API cookbooks describe credentials issued only 'upon subscribing to the Downdetector Enterprise API'; plan pages confirm API access sits in the Enterprise tier.
notes: The job ('is X up?') is simple to rebuild natively: an HTTP probe + public status-page check (already the spirit of our in-house monitoring). Downgrade: build outage_check ourselves instead of buying the enterprise door.
